entities.title: Screens and games
entities.summary: No automated test drives the screens, an online game, the computer game or a replay.

checks.description: With npm run dev and DEV_LOGIN=1, play two players in two browsers (or one private window): invite, accept, play to the end with chat and a draw offer, rematch; play the computer, reload, Continue, Take back; replay a game at each pace.
